_about: Self-written paraphrases (not public-sample wording) with expected directives. capacity_kwh = 200 for every note.

notes.note: PV production will drop to about 20% between 13:00 and 15:00.
Panel washing from one until three will leave roughly one-fifth of normal solar output.
Expect an 80% reduction in rooftop solar during the 1-3 PM maintenance window.
Heavy monsoon clouds should halve solar generation from 9 AM to noon.
Scaffolding will shade the arrays, cutting PV yield by 40 percent from 10:00 until 14:00.
One inverter string is offline from 11 AM to 1 PM, so only three quarters of the forecast solar is usable.
Solar panels will produce nothing between 2 PM and 4 PM while the roof is inspected.
Dust haze will reduce usable solar to 30% of forecast for the 3 PM hour.
Maintain a minimum of 150 kWh in storage from 7 PM to 11 PM.
The battery must never drop under 60 percent of its capacity between 17:00 and 20:00 for hospital backup.
Hold half the battery capacity in reserve from 8 PM until midnight.
Emergency lighting needs at least 75 kWh kept in the battery from midnight to 4 AM.
Security wants a 110 kWh cushion in the battery during 6-8 PM.
Charging is prohibited between 9 AM and 11 AM due to a BMS firmware update.
The battery cannot accept energy from 13:00 to 16:00 while the charge controller is replaced.
Electricians will lock out the charger from 10 PM to 1 AM.
No battery charging during the 7 AM hour because of a breaker test.
Battery discharging is not allowed from 4 PM until 6 PM during insulation testing.
The storage system may not supply the campus between 20:00 and 23:00 while the protection relay is recalibrated.
Keep the battery from delivering power from noon to 2 PM for a fire-safety check.
Grid purchases are capped at 120 kWh per hour from 5 PM to 8 PM.
The utility asks us to draw no more than 200 kWh from the grid in each hour between 18:00 and 22:00.
Because of transformer overheating, grid import is limited to 90 kWh from 1 PM until 3 PM.
Demand response event: keep utility import at or below 140 kWh from 6 to 9 PM.

Parking lot B will be repainted on Saturday.

The battery vendor will send an invoice by email next month.
Exam results will be announced at 3 PM.
